title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.OPS #CONNECTOR-HEALTH: Connector health: expiry watch, silent refresh, auto reconnect card
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/auth/routes.js
code-anchor: GET  /auth/health

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.OPS
**Metric it should move:** reliability
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call (fleet_budget cap is breached; cost 426.89 vs 300).
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::connector.*expires_at ; merged and verified live (VERIFY-LIVE-1) with a probe the author did not write
**Status:** closed

Every linked connector gets last_ok, expires_at and a refresh attempt each tick (no new cron; ride the existing tick). A connector failing twice raises one reconnect card with the consent link as the button. Prediction: expired-connector incidents (bootstrap-log item 7) go to 0 unattended; metric reliability and owner_load.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 168.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
